item.title: By: River Wolf
item.dc:creator: River Wolf
item.description: It's funny how you compare humans with dogs, because being born in the year of the dog, my primitive Taoist attitude to life somehow resembles this hungry, non-thinking dog you write about. Perhaps it might be good, but "dog people" are commonly criticised for being "dogmatic!"
item.content:encoded: It’s funny how you compare humans with dogs, because being born in the year of the dog, my primitive Taoist attitude to life somehow resembles this hungry, non-thinking dog you write about. Perhaps it might be good, but “dog people” are commonly criticised for being “dogmatic!”
